panels.title: a | Recorded FlyWire circuit activity
panels.caption: Saved Browser WASM run of FlyWire DM1 (dm1-240, reference-f64): 240 neurons, 300 ms of biological time and 2,796 recorded spikes in the full run. Replay is positioned at 270 ms. The current catalogue supplies the six-group network layout; colors and displayed rates come from saved measurements. This is recorded activity replay, not a new simulation or the B2IR schedule.

panels.title: b | B2IR model draft and logical execution cycle
panels.caption: Corresponding online FlyWire DM1 model-page B2IR draft, at the 240-neuron scale with default parameters: one execution population, 6,660 synapses and seven scheduled operations. This draft is not the archived execution artifact of panel a. Biological groups in the network diagram and execution populations in B2IR serve different purposes. The runtime validates the final bundle on execution.

panels.title: c | Synaptic delivery, dependencies and operations
panels.caption: The selected flywire_recurrent_pre node depends on the state updater and spike thresholder. It reads postsynaptic conductances, inhibitory gain, recurrent weight, signed contacts and presynaptic transmission, and writes ge_post, gi_post. The displayed operations separate excitatory and inhibitory conductance updates. This is logical schedule inspection; the complete target-specific physical plan is not shown.
